recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Follow up in the FHIR Extension Pack by restoring or adding the Provenance.agent Location extension using current extension-pack conventions, or ask Security to explicitly confirm that the Published FHIR-20531 extension request is obsolete.
issue_request: FHIR-20531 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Provenance. It asked whether later activity should update an existing Provenance or create a new Provenance, and the final resolution was to add an extension for recording the Location of a Provenance.agent.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied through HL7/fhir#708. Commit b569c4406b1d2a7944cc4b25869f7075524fe4f3 added a provenance extension spreadsheet row named location, context Provenance.agent, cardinality 0..*, type Reference(Location), and text 'Location of the agent.'
additional_context: Current core source still has Provenance in build scope and its narrative already says multiple activities that result in one target are recorded as independent Provenance records. The active StructureDefinition has activity-level Provenance.location but no Provenance.agent.location element or agent-location extension source. Commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 deleted the Provenance extension spreadsheet during source rework without migrating this extension. Searches of the FHIR Extension Pack checkout found no replacement Provenance.agent location extension. FHIR-32450 later clarified AuditEvent.agent.location and is already represented on the combined branch, but it does not satisfy this Provenance extension request.
reconciliation: Created an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was changed because restoring the extension in this checkout would target an out-of-current-build core extension source location; the remaining correction belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack or needs Security work-group confirmation that the historical extension should be retired.
